RagShortTexts: Hills and wetlands support dispersed movement.
Coastal war requires vessels, weather and safe routes home.

Variants.Content: Hills and wetlands favor dispersed movement; sailing needs wind, tides and landings. Roman war requires warnings, food and routes home rather than every guard marching south.

Hills and wetlands support dispersed movement. These forces remain limited by food, rest and loads; vanguard speed does not represent the whole column. Coastal war requires vessels, weather and safe routes home.

Coastal war requires vessels, weather and safe routes home. Usable strength includes supply, home guards and exits; concentration reduces another reserve. Hills and wetlands support dispersed movement.
Hills and wetlands support dispersed movement. Fighters come from households; prolonged loss of labor or animals weakens the next levy. Coastal war requires vessels, weather and safe routes home.
Coastal war requires vessels, weather and safe routes home. Repair, carrying and care also use people, while daily supply continues after troops pass. Hills and wetlands support dispersed movement.
